text: ∀x (Place(x) ∧ VenueForLiveStagePerformances(x) ∧ (HasStage(x) ∨ HasCurtains(x) ∨ HasAudienceSeating(x)) ∧ (HostsPlays(x) ∨ HostsMusicals(x) ∨ HostsOtherProductions(x)) → Theater(x)) ::: A place is considered a theater if it is a venue for live stage performances, often with a stage, curtains, and audience seating, and hosting plays, musicals, or other productions.
